en: Praise to Vajrasattva: I pay homage to the glorious Vajrasattva, the supreme teacher of the world, the embodiment of all Buddhas, the Lord of Victors who manifests in diverse forms, who removes the fear of darkness, who is manifested as the peaceful Meru.

The mandala of the Vajradhātu, the support of the Dharma for the Munis, which bestows the auspicious qualities of the Jinas, whose singular form is all-bliss, consisting of supreme happiness, and which is the cause of liberation for embodied beings. || 1 ||
He is the moonbeam that dispels the dense darkness of delusion for beings submerged in the ocean of the thick gloom of ignorance;
having manifested wisdom, he has fulfilled his vigor and meditative concentration.
I bow my head to the incomparable Śrī Vajrasattva. ||2||
In which [teaching], the multitudes of gods, asuras, lords of gods, and lords of men—
having fallen at your lotus feet like bees—
[find] that great treasure-trove of the ocean for accomplishing spiritual perfection.
I go for refuge to the feet of the glorious Lokanātha. || 3 ||
To the Buddha, Lord of the three worlds, saluted by the best of gods, who has crossed to the further shore of saṃsāra,
the steadfast one possessed of profundity, a treasury of all virtues, consecrated as the King of Dharma;
who removes the darkness of craving and delusion, dispels the impurities of the Kali age, and protects from desire and greed.
I bow to that Lion of the Śākyas; with my head bowed low, I pay homage to him at all times. || 4 ||
I bow down to the Lord named Amoghapāśa, the protector of the world, who arises from the syllable Hrīṃ and whose mind is tender with compassion. (5)
I bow to that Dharmadhātu, the Caitya which is the abode of all Buddhas, the relic of the Jina, and the source of Māmakī, Locanā, Tārā, and Padminī. (6)
Homage to Tārā, the swift hero, Tuttāre, the destroyer of fear;
O Ture, at the time of every affliction, I bow to you who utter Svāhā. 7.
I pay homage to the Lion of the Śākyas, the Teacher Samantabhadra, whose eyes are the White Lotus of the True Dharma and who is an ocean of the qualities of omniscience. (8)
The Praise to Śrī Vajrasattva is complete.
